articles.title: 'PM forgiving me is a very big thing': Noida teen who 'abused' Modi apologises again
articles.description: A 15-year-old girl expressed immense relief after Prime Minister Narendra Modi's forgiving message. She felt she received a second chance after making deeply regrettable and offensive statements. The teenager explained she was influenced by others at a protest and later apologized. She is now receiving threats and facing ongoing police inquiries regarding the incident. The girl stated she will not repeat such actions and seeks acceptance of her apology.

articles.title: The promise, the pain and the gold: Asmita Dey's journey to CWG history
articles.description: Asmita Dey's historic Commonwealth Games gold was shaped by far more than what happened on the judo mat. After losing her father, battling a Grade-2 ankle injury and overcoming severe financial hardship, the Tripura judoka found unwavering support in coach Yashapal Solanki, who stood by her like a father. Their emotional embrace after the final told the story of resilience, sacrifice and a dream fulfilled against overwhelming odds.

articles.title: 3 killed in US Idaho shopping area shooting; gunman among dead
articles.description: Three people died and two were injured after a gunman opened fire. The shooter was also among the deceased, with authorities investigating the motive. The chaotic scene unfolded near a busy In-N-Out Burger restaurant on Saturday afternoon. Witnesses described seeing an armed individual and people fleeing the area in fear. Law enforcement confirmed the threat to the community was over after the incident.

articles.title: UPI transactions touch Rs 76cr/day, FASTag declines
articles.description: UPI processed 2,366 crore transactions in July, showing significant year-on-year growth. NETC FASTag transactions declined by 6% compared to the previous year. The value of UPI transactions rose to Rs 29.88 lakh crore in July. NETC FASTag transaction value also saw a decrease from the prior month. UPI handled an average of 76.3 crore transactions daily in July.

articles.title: 'Unmadham' records 11.4% growth
articles.description: Kunchacko Boban's latest Malayalam thriller 'Unmadham' saw a positive box office jump on its second day. The film earned an estimated Rs 78 lakhs on Saturday, showing improved collections from Friday. Its total India net collection has now reached Rs 1.48 crore after two days. Occupancy rates improved significantly throughout Saturday, especially during evening shows. The crime thriller follows a police officer investigating a mysterious suicide case.
